<script id="wpcom_remote_login_js">
var wpcom_remote_login_extra_auth = '';
function wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( element_id ) {
	var dom_node = document.getElementById( element_id );
	if ( dom_node ) { dom_node.parentNode.removeChild( dom_node ); }
}
function wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_classes( class_name ) {
	var dom_nodes = document.querySelectorAll( '.' + class_name );
	for ( var i = 0; i < dom_nodes.length; i++ ) {
		dom_nodes[ i ].parentNode.removeChild( dom_nodes[ i ] );
	}
}
function wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup() {
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_classes( "wpcom_remote_login_msg" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_key" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_validate" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_js" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_request_access_iframe" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_request_access_styles" );
}

// Watch for messages back from the remote login
window.addEventListener( "message", function( e ) {
	if ( e.origin === "https://r-login.wordpress.com" ) {
		var data = {};
		try {
			data = JSON.parse( e.data );
		} catch( e ) {
			wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup();
			return;
		}

		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN' ) {
			// Clean up the login check iframe
			wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_key" );

			var id_regex = new RegExp( /^[0-9]+$/ );
			var token_regex = new RegExp( /^.*|.*|.*$/ );
			if (
				token_regex.test( data.token )
				&& id_regex.test( data.wpcomid )
			) {
				// We have everything we need to ask for a login
				var script = document.createElement( "script" );
				script.setAttribute( "id", "wpcom_remote_login_validate" );
				script.src = '/remote-login.php?wpcom_remote_login=validate'
					+ '&wpcomid=' + data.wpcomid
					+ '&token=' + encodeURIComponent( data.token )
					+ '&host=' + window.location.protocol
					+ '//' + window.location.hostname
					+ '&postid=100527541'
					+ '&is_singular=';
				document.body.appendChild( script );
			}

			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP, not logged in, so redirect
		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN-REDIRECT' ) {
			window.location = 'https://wordpress.com/log-in?redirect_to=' + window.location.href;
			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP, storage access failed, remove the request
		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN-REMOVE' ) {
			var css_zap = 'html { -webkit-transition: margin-top 1s; transition: margin-top 1s; } /* 9001 */ html { margin-top: 0 !important; } * html body { margin-top: 0 !important; } @media screen and ( max-width: 782px ) { html { margin-top: 0 !important; } * html body { margin-top: 0 !important; } }';
			var style_zap = document.createElement( 'style' );
			style_zap.type = 'text/css';
			style_zap.appendChild( document.createTextNode( css_zap ) );
			document.body.appendChild( style_zap );

			var e = document.getElementById( 'wpcom_request_access_iframe' );
			e.parentNode.removeChild( e );

			document.cookie = 'wordpress_com_login_access=denied; path=/; max-age=31536000';

			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP
		if ( data.msg === 'REQUEST_ACCESS' ) {
			console.log( 'request access: safari' );

			// Check ITP iframe enable/disable knob
			if ( wpcom_remote_login_extra_auth !== 'safari_itp_iframe' ) {
				return;
			}

			// If we are in a "private window" there is no ITP.
			var private_window = false;
			try {
				var opendb = window.openDatabase( null, null, null, null );
			} catch( e ) {
				private_window = true;
			}

			if ( private_window ) {
				console.log( 'private window' );
				return;
			}

			var iframe = document.createElement( 'iframe' );
			iframe.id = 'wpcom_request_access_iframe';
			iframe.setAttribute( 'scrolling', 'no' );
			iframe.setAttribute( 'sandbox', 'allow-storage-access-by-user-activation allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation' );
			iframe.src = 'https://r-login.wordpress.com/remote-login.php?wpcom_remote_login=request_access&origin=' + encodeURIComponent( data.origin ) + '&wpcomid=' + encodeURIComponent( data.wpcomid );

			var css = 'html { -webkit-transition: margin-top 1s; transition: margin-top 1s; } /* 9001 */ html { margin-top: 46px !important; } * html body { margin-top: 46px !important; } @media screen and ( max-width: 660px ) { html { margin-top: 71px !important; } * html body { margin-top: 71px !important; } #wpcom_request_access_iframe { display: block; height: 71px !important; } } #wpcom_request_access_iframe { border: 0px; height: 46px; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; min-width: 100%; z-index: 99999; background: #23282d; } ';

			var style = document.createElement( 'style' );
			style.type = 'text/css';
			style.id = 'wpcom_request_access_styles';
			style.appendChild( document.createTextNode( css ) );
			document.body.appendChild( style );

			document.body.appendChild( iframe );
		}

		if ( data.msg === 'DONE' ) {
			wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup();
		}
	}
}, false );

// Inject the remote login iframe after the page has had a chance to load
// more critical resources
window.addEventListener( "DOMContentLoaded", function( e ) {
	var iframe = document.createElement( "iframe" );
	iframe.style.display = "none";
	iframe.setAttribute( "scrolling", "no" );
	iframe.setAttribute( "id", "wpcom_remote_login_key" );
	iframe.src = "https://r-login.wordpress.com/remote-login.php"
		+ "?wpcom_remote_login=key"
		+ "&origin=aHR0cHM6Ly9qZXRwYWNrLmNvbQ%3D%3D"
		+ "&wpcomid=256526497"
		+ "&time=" + Math.floor( Date.now() / 1000 );
	document.body.appendChild( iframe );
}, false );
</script>

<script id="wpcom_remote_login_js">
var wpcom_remote_login_extra_auth = '';
function wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( element_id ) {
	var dom_node = document.getElementById( element_id );
	if ( dom_node ) { dom_node.parentNode.removeChild( dom_node ); }
}
function wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_classes( class_name ) {
	var dom_nodes = document.querySelectorAll( '.' + class_name );
	for ( var i = 0; i < dom_nodes.length; i++ ) {
		dom_nodes[ i ].parentNode.removeChild( dom_nodes[ i ] );
	}
}
function wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup() {
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_classes( "wpcom_remote_login_msg" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_key" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_validate" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_js" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_request_access_iframe" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_request_access_styles" );
}

// Watch for messages back from the remote login
window.addEventListener( "message", function( e ) {
	if ( e.origin === "https://r-login.wordpress.com" ) {
		var data = {};
		try {
			data = JSON.parse( e.data );
		} catch( e ) {
			wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup();
			return;
		}

		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN' ) {
			// Clean up the login check iframe
			wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_key" );

			var id_regex = new RegExp( /^[0-9]+$/ );
			var token_regex = new RegExp( /^.*|.*|.*$/ );
			if (
				token_regex.test( data.token )
				&& id_regex.test( data.wpcomid )
			) {
				// We have everything we need to ask for a login
				var script = document.createElement( "script" );
				script.setAttribute( "id", "wpcom_remote_login_validate" );
				script.src = '/remote-login.php?wpcom_remote_login=validate'
					+ '&wpcomid=' + data.wpcomid
					+ '&token=' + encodeURIComponent( data.token )
					+ '&host=' + window.location.protocol
					+ '//' + window.location.hostname
					+ '&postid=522401'
					+ '&is_singular=';
				document.body.appendChild( script );
			}

			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP, not logged in, so redirect
		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN-REDIRECT' ) {
			window.location = 'https://wordpress.com/log-in?redirect_to=' + window.location.href;
			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP, storage access failed, remove the request
		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN-REMOVE' ) {
			var css_zap = 'html { -webkit-transition: margin-top 1s; transition: margin-top 1s; } /* 9001 */ html { margin-top: 0 !important; } * html body { margin-top: 0 !important; } @media screen and ( max-width: 782px ) { html { margin-top: 0 !important; } * html body { margin-top: 0 !important; } }';
			var style_zap = document.createElement( 'style' );
			style_zap.type = 'text/css';
			style_zap.appendChild( document.createTextNode( css_zap ) );
			document.body.appendChild( style_zap );

			var e = document.getElementById( 'wpcom_request_access_iframe' );
			e.parentNode.removeChild( e );

			document.cookie = 'wordpress_com_login_access=denied; path=/; max-age=31536000';

			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP
		if ( data.msg === 'REQUEST_ACCESS' ) {
			console.log( 'request access: safari' );

			// Check ITP iframe enable/disable knob
			if ( wpcom_remote_login_extra_auth !== 'safari_itp_iframe' ) {
				return;
			}

			// If we are in a "private window" there is no ITP.
			var private_window = false;
			try {
				var opendb = window.openDatabase( null, null, null, null );
			} catch( e ) {
				private_window = true;
			}

			if ( private_window ) {
				console.log( 'private window' );
				return;
			}

			var iframe = document.createElement( 'iframe' );
			iframe.id = 'wpcom_request_access_iframe';
			iframe.setAttribute( 'scrolling', 'no' );
			iframe.setAttribute( 'sandbox', 'allow-storage-access-by-user-activation allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation' );
			iframe.src = 'https://r-login.wordpress.com/remote-login.php?wpcom_remote_login=request_access&origin=' + encodeURIComponent( data.origin ) + '&wpcomid=' + encodeURIComponent( data.wpcomid );

			var css = 'html { -webkit-transition: margin-top 1s; transition: margin-top 1s; } /* 9001 */ html { margin-top: 46px !important; } * html body { margin-top: 46px !important; } @media screen and ( max-width: 660px ) { html { margin-top: 71px !important; } * html body { margin-top: 71px !important; } #wpcom_request_access_iframe { display: block; height: 71px !important; } } #wpcom_request_access_iframe { border: 0px; height: 46px; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; min-width: 100%; z-index: 99999; background: #23282d; } ';

			var style = document.createElement( 'style' );
			style.type = 'text/css';
			style.id = 'wpcom_request_access_styles';
			style.appendChild( document.createTextNode( css ) );
			document.body.appendChild( style );

			document.body.appendChild( iframe );
		}

		if ( data.msg === 'DONE' ) {
			wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup();
		}
	}
}, false );

// Inject the remote login iframe after the page has had a chance to load
// more critical resources
window.addEventListener( "DOMContentLoaded", function( e ) {
	var iframe = document.createElement( "iframe" );
	iframe.style.display = "none";
	iframe.setAttribute( "scrolling", "no" );
	iframe.setAttribute( "id", "wpcom_remote_login_key" );
	iframe.src = "https://r-login.wordpress.com/remote-login.php"
		+ "?wpcom_remote_login=key"
		+ "&origin=aHR0cHM6Ly9qZXRwYWNrLmNvbQ%3D%3D"
		+ "&wpcomid=256526497"
		+ "&time=" + Math.floor( Date.now() / 1000 );
	document.body.appendChild( iframe );
}, false );
</script>

		<div class="wf-faq">
			<div class="wf-faq__intro wf-r">
				<h2 class="wf-faq__title" id="wf-faq-title-12">Your questions, answered.</h2>
								<p class="wf-faq__sub">For anything else, our Happiness Engineers can help.</p>
												<a class="wf-band__btn wf-faq__btn" href="https://jetpack.com/contact-support/">Contact us</a>
							</div>
			<div class="wf-faq__list wf-r">
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>Do I have to pay to connect my agent?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>No. Agents are free to connect on every Jetpack site. Agent access stays off until you turn it on. Restoring a change needs VaultPress Backup, which is included in Security and Complete.</p>
</div>
				</details>
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>Which AI can I connect?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients. Your agent never gets more access than your own WordPress role.</p>
</div>
				</details>
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>What if my agent gets something wrong?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>Every action is logged and changes wait for your OK. With VaultPress Backup you can restore your site to the moment before the change.</p>
</div>
				</details>
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>My host already backs up my site. Why Jetpack?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>Jetpack saves as you work, keeps copies off your server, logs every change and comes with you if you move hosts.</p>
</div>
				</details>
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>Isn’t Jetpack heavy?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>Switch off anything you don’t use. Backups, scans and image resizing run on Jetpack’s cloud, not on your server.</p>
</div>
				</details>
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>What’s free?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>The free plan includes downtime monitoring, stats, and brute force protection. AI agents are free to connect too. Backups come with paid plans.</p>
</div>
				</details>
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>Do I have to use AI?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>No. Agent access is off until you turn it on, and the rest of Jetpack works without it.</p>
</div>
				</details>
								<details class="wf-faq__item" name="wf-faq-13">
					<summary><span>Why do I need a WordPress.com account?</span><svg class="wf-faq__icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"><path d="M10 4v12M4 10h12"/></svg></summary>
					<div class="wf-faq__a"><p>It connects your site to Jetpack’s cloud, where backups, scans and stats run. The account is free.</p>
</div>
				</details>

		<script>
			( function () {
				const widget = document.getElementById( 'jp-presales-chat' );
				if ( ! widget ) {
					return;
				}
				/*
				 * Keystrokes inside the widget's shadow DOM are retargeted to the
				 * <chat-widget> host, so document-level shortcut handlers (e.g. the
				 * wp.com masterbar's "n" notifications toggle) can't tell the user is
				 * typing in an input. Keep keyboard events inside the widget.
				 */
				[ 'keydown', 'keypress', 'keyup' ].forEach( function ( type ) {
					widget.addEventListener( type, function ( event ) {
						event.stopPropagation();
					} );
				} );
			} )();

			( () => {
				const track = ( event, props ) => window.jetpackComTrack?.( event, props );

				// Same page-name slug as the theme's jetpack_com_page_view, so these
				// events slice by identical page values.
				const segments = window.location.pathname.split( '/' ).filter( Boolean );
				const props    = {
					page: ( segments.length ? segments.join( '_' ) : 'home' ).replace( /-/g, '_' ),
					url: window.location.href,
					logged_in: false				};

				const host = document.getElementById( 'jp-presales-chat' );
				if ( ! host ) {
					return;
				}

				// Clicks on links inside the chat, e.g. the Help Center link in a bot reply.
				// The listener and the link stripping are shared with the contact-support
				// chat (src/chat-link-tracking.ts). This inline script can't import them,
				// so it calls them through window once src/tracking.ts has loaded.
				const attachLinkClicks = () => {
					if ( ! window.jetpackComTrackChatLinks ) {
						return false;
					}
					window.jetpackComTrackChatLinks( host, 'jetpack_com_presales_chat_link_click', props );
					return true;
				};

				// Tracking becomes available at DOMContentLoaded, so use the readiness poll.
				let impressionSent = false;
				const sendImpression = () => {
					if ( ! impressionSent && window.jetpackComTrack ) {
						impressionSent = true;
						track( 'jetpack_com_presales_chat_impression', props );
					}
					return impressionSent;
				};

				let engaged = false;

				// Engagement: the first message the visitor sends.
				const attachEngagement = () => {
					const inner = host.shadowRoot?.querySelector( 'deep-chat' );
					if ( ! inner ) {
						return false;
					}
					inner.addEventListener( 'new-message', ( event ) => {
						const message = event?.detail?.message;
						// Skip messages replayed from history (isInitial) so revisiting a
						// page with a prior conversation doesn't count as fresh engagement.
						if ( engaged || event?.detail?.isInitial || ! message || message.role !== 'user' ) {
							return;
						}
						engaged = true;
						track( 'jetpack_com_presales_chat_engaged', props );
					} );
					return true;
				};

				// Open: the visitor clicks the launcher icon to open the chat. The
				// listener is attached on the inner #chat-widget in the capture phase
				// so it runs before the widget's own #chat-icon handler toggles the
				// `open` class — this lets us read the state before the toggle. The
				// same launcher also closes the chat, so we only record the open
				// direction (widget currently closed).
				const attachOpen = () => {
					const root   = host.shadowRoot;
					const widget = root?.querySelector( '#chat-widget' );
					const icon   = root?.querySelector( '#chat-icon' );
					if ( ! widget || ! icon ) {
						return false;
					}
					widget.addEventListener( 'click', ( event ) => {
						if ( ! event.composedPath().includes( icon ) || widget.classList.contains( 'open' ) ) {
							return;
						}
						updatePanelMaxHeight();
						track( 'jetpack_com_presales_chat_opened', props );
					}, true );
					return true;
				};

				// The vendored desktop panel is fixed at 700px, so cap it against the
				// measured header while leaving its <= 768px full-screen rule in control.
				// Clamp at zero rather than a positive floor: a floor larger than the
				// space available would make the panel overlap the header again, and a
				// negative max-height is invalid CSS, which would drop the declaration
				// and restore the hardcoded 700px.
				const updatePanelMaxHeight = () => {
					const top = document.querySelector( '.jetpack-header' )?.getBoundingClientRect().bottom || 0;
					host.style.setProperty( '--jp-chat-max-height', Math.max( 0, window.innerHeight - top - 110 ) + 'px' );
				};

				let headerEventsAttached   = false;
				let headerObserverAttached = false;
				let resizeAttached         = false;
				const clampPanel = () => {
					const root = host.shadowRoot;
					if ( ! root ) {
						return false;
					}

					if ( ! root.getElementById( 'jp-presales-chat-viewport-clamp' ) ) {
						const style = document.createElement( 'style' );
						style.id = 'jp-presales-chat-viewport-clamp';
						style.textContent = '@media (min-width: 768.02px){#chat-content{max-height:var(--jp-chat-max-height,none)}}';
						root.appendChild( style );
					}

					updatePanelMaxHeight();
					const header = document.querySelector( '.jetpack-header' );
					if ( ! headerEventsAttached && header ) {
						// Transforms move the header without resizing it, so ResizeObserver cannot
						// catch them; remeasure after motion and when the launcher opens.
						headerEventsAttached = true;
						header.addEventListener( 'animationend', updatePanelMaxHeight );
						header.addEventListener( 'transitionend', updatePanelMaxHeight );
					}
					if ( ! headerObserverAttached && header && window.ResizeObserver ) {
						// The admin bar and other late layout shifts can resize the header after the first measurement.
						headerObserverAttached = true;
						new window.ResizeObserver( updatePanelMaxHeight ).observe( header );
					}
					if ( ! resizeAttached ) {
						resizeAttached = true;
						let resizeFrame = 0;
						window.addEventListener( 'resize', () => {
							if ( resizeFrame ) {
								return;
							}
							resizeFrame = window.requestAnimationFrame( () => {
								resizeFrame = 0;
								updatePanelMaxHeight();
							} );
						} );
					}

					return true;
				};

				let engagementDone = false;
				let openDone       = false;
				let clampDone      = false;
				let linksDone      = false;
				const attachAll    = () => {
					engagementDone = engagementDone || attachEngagement();
					openDone       = openDone || attachOpen();
					clampDone      = clampDone || clampPanel();
					linksDone      = linksDone || attachLinkClicks();

<script id="wpcom_remote_login_js">
var wpcom_remote_login_extra_auth = '';
function wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( element_id ) {
	var dom_node = document.getElementById( element_id );
	if ( dom_node ) { dom_node.parentNode.removeChild( dom_node ); }
}
function wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_classes( class_name ) {
	var dom_nodes = document.querySelectorAll( '.' + class_name );
	for ( var i = 0; i < dom_nodes.length; i++ ) {
		dom_nodes[ i ].parentNode.removeChild( dom_nodes[ i ] );
	}
}
function wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup() {
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_classes( "wpcom_remote_login_msg" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_key" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_validate" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_js" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_request_access_iframe" );
	wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_request_access_styles" );
}

// Watch for messages back from the remote login
window.addEventListener( "message", function( e ) {
	if ( e.origin === "https://r-login.wordpress.com" ) {
		var data = {};
		try {
			data = JSON.parse( e.data );
		} catch( e ) {
			wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup();
			return;
		}

		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN' ) {
			// Clean up the login check iframe
			wpcom_remote_login_remove_dom_node_id( "wpcom_remote_login_key" );

			var id_regex = new RegExp( /^[0-9]+$/ );
			var token_regex = new RegExp( /^.*|.*|.*$/ );
			if (
				token_regex.test( data.token )
				&& id_regex.test( data.wpcomid )
			) {
				// We have everything we need to ask for a login
				var script = document.createElement( "script" );
				script.setAttribute( "id", "wpcom_remote_login_validate" );
				script.src = '/remote-login.php?wpcom_remote_login=validate'
					+ '&wpcomid=' + data.wpcomid
					+ '&token=' + encodeURIComponent( data.token )
					+ '&host=' + window.location.protocol
					+ '//' + window.location.hostname
					+ '&postid=100527541'
					+ '&is_singular=';
				document.body.appendChild( script );
			}

			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP, not logged in, so redirect
		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN-REDIRECT' ) {
			window.location = 'https://wordpress.com/log-in?redirect_to=' + window.location.href;
			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP, storage access failed, remove the request
		if ( data.msg === 'LOGIN-REMOVE' ) {
			var css_zap = 'html { -webkit-transition: margin-top 1s; transition: margin-top 1s; } /* 9001 */ html { margin-top: 0 !important; } * html body { margin-top: 0 !important; } @media screen and ( max-width: 782px ) { html { margin-top: 0 !important; } * html body { margin-top: 0 !important; } }';
			var style_zap = document.createElement( 'style' );
			style_zap.type = 'text/css';
			style_zap.appendChild( document.createTextNode( css_zap ) );
			document.body.appendChild( style_zap );

			var e = document.getElementById( 'wpcom_request_access_iframe' );
			e.parentNode.removeChild( e );

			document.cookie = 'wordpress_com_login_access=denied; path=/; max-age=31536000';

			return;
		}

		// Safari ITP
		if ( data.msg === 'REQUEST_ACCESS' ) {
			console.log( 'request access: safari' );

			// Check ITP iframe enable/disable knob
			if ( wpcom_remote_login_extra_auth !== 'safari_itp_iframe' ) {
				return;
			}

			// If we are in a "private window" there is no ITP.
			var private_window = false;
			try {
				var opendb = window.openDatabase( null, null, null, null );
			} catch( e ) {
				private_window = true;
			}

			if ( private_window ) {
				console.log( 'private window' );
				return;
			}

			var iframe = document.createElement( 'iframe' );
			iframe.id = 'wpcom_request_access_iframe';
			iframe.setAttribute( 'scrolling', 'no' );
			iframe.setAttribute( 'sandbox', 'allow-storage-access-by-user-activation allow-scripts allow-same-origin allow-top-navigation-by-user-activation' );
			iframe.src = 'https://r-login.wordpress.com/remote-login.php?wpcom_remote_login=request_access&origin=' + encodeURIComponent( data.origin ) + '&wpcomid=' + encodeURIComponent( data.wpcomid );

			var css = 'html { -webkit-transition: margin-top 1s; transition: margin-top 1s; } /* 9001 */ html { margin-top: 46px !important; } * html body { margin-top: 46px !important; } @media screen and ( max-width: 660px ) { html { margin-top: 71px !important; } * html body { margin-top: 71px !important; } #wpcom_request_access_iframe { display: block; height: 71px !important; } } #wpcom_request_access_iframe { border: 0px; height: 46px; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; min-width: 100%; z-index: 99999; background: #23282d; } ';

			var style = document.createElement( 'style' );
			style.type = 'text/css';
			style.id = 'wpcom_request_access_styles';
			style.appendChild( document.createTextNode( css ) );
			document.body.appendChild( style );

			document.body.appendChild( iframe );
		}

		if ( data.msg === 'DONE' ) {
			wpcom_remote_login_final_cleanup();
		}
	}
}, false );

// Inject the remote login iframe after the page has had a chance to load
// more critical resources
window.addEventListener( "DOMContentLoaded", function( e ) {
	var iframe = document.createElement( "iframe" );
	iframe.style.display = "none";
	iframe.setAttribute( "scrolling", "no" );
	iframe.setAttribute( "id", "wpcom_remote_login_key" );
	iframe.src = "https://r-login.wordpress.com/remote-login.php"
		+ "?wpcom_remote_login=key"
		+ "&origin=aHR0cHM6Ly9qZXRwYWNrLmNvbQ%3D%3D"
		+ "&wpcomid=256526497"
		+ "&time=" + Math.floor( Date.now() / 1000 );
	document.body.appendChild( iframe );
}, false );
</script>

					const originalURL = `${ document.location.href }?page_id=${ post_id }`;

						}
					};

						setTimeout( redirect, 0 );
					} else {
